# keret

> A free, open-source photo wall builder: a folder of photographs becomes one static page you pan and zoom, every frame captioned from the file's own EXIF. No account, nothing uploaded, no AI in the runtime, MIT licensed.

## Core pages

- [Landing page](https://keret.nomorenames.studio/): What keret is, what a wall looks like, and the FAQ
- [The builder](https://keret.nomorenames.studio/app/): Drop a folder in a browser tab, get the finished site as a zip — nothing is uploaded
- [A live wall](https://nomorenamesstudio.github.io/keret/): 105 photographs, every frame captioned from its own EXIF
- [GitHub Repo](https://github.com/nomorenamesstudio/keret): Source code, issues, the CLI
- [Hosting guide](https://keret.nomorenames.studio/hosting): GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, Netlify or your own nginx, custom domain included
- [FAQ / Why It Exists](https://keret.nomorenames.studio/#why): Origin story, privacy, free vs paid
- [License](https://github.com/nomorenamesstudio/keret/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT
